nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Entry only. Never trust tenant_id / role from the request body alone; every downstream step re-verifies from the database.

parameters.query: SELECT id, role, is_active FROM owners WHERE id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.admin_owner_id }}' AND role = 'admin' AND is_active = true LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Validate Admin
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Only a registered admin owner (role='admin', tenant_id NULL per schema) may run admin-ops. A non-admin caller is rejected loudly by the next Code node; no status or toggle is ever written for them.

nodes.name: Route by String Flag
nodes.notes: DRAFT. The flag whitelist is the router. An unknown flag is an error, never a default action.

parameters.query: UPDATE tenants SET status = 'live', updated_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.target_tenant_id }}' AND status = 'live_pending_admin' AND '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.action }}' = 'approve_live' RETURNING id, status;

nodes.name: Approve Live (guarded)
nodes.notes: DRAFT. approve_live ONLY moves live_pending_admin -> live. It never activates a trial tenant directly and never approves a channel by itself — the channel token + channels row are a separate step.

parameters.query: UPDATE tenants SET status = 'paused', updated_at = now() WHERE id = '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.target_tenant_id }}' AND '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.action }}' = 'pause_tenant' RETURNING id, status;

nodes.name: Pause Tenant (guarded)
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Pausing a tenant pauses all its channels with it (adapters reject paused tenants at resolve time).

parameters.query: INSERT INTO tenant_services (tenant_id, service_code, is_active, activated_at) VALUES ('{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.target_tenant_id }}', '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.service_code }}', {{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.desired_active }}, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, service_code) DO UPDATE SET is_active = {{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.desired_active }}, activated_at = now() WHERE '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.action }}' = 'toggle_service';

nodes.name: Toggle Service (guarded)
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Toggle is a config-row change, effective on the next execution, with no redeploy and no effect on other tenants. desired_active is validated as a real boolean by the Route node, so the SQL never receives a missing value for this action.

parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS total_cost_usd, COALESCE(SUM(messages_count), 0) AS messages FROM usage_daily GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC;

nodes.name: Cost Report (guarded)
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Dashboards read from usage_daily only, never from raw usage_events rows. This SELECT is harmless for any action flag; the Alert node below sums it only when action='cost_report'.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO admin_audit (tenant_id, admin_owner_id, action, target, details) SELECT '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.target_tenant_id }}', '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.admin_owner_id }}', '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.action }}', 'tenant', '{"service_code": "{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.service_code }}"}'::jsonb WHERE '{{ $('Route by String Flag').first().json.action }}' <> 'cost_report';

nodes.name: Audit Admin Action
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Every mutating admin action is audited in the admin's name. A read-only cost_report writes no mutation audit.

nodes.name: Cost Alert Check
nodes.notes: DRAFT. $50 alert / $100 stop are flags in the output, not a send. Do not claim an alert was delivered until a delivery step exists.

nodes.name: Build Admin Output
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Output confirms the flag that ran and the alert flags. No password, no token, no platform secret.

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Returns the workflow output object only. Never returns a password, token, or API key.
